name: grammar

plugins.name: grammar
plugins.description: Checks the English of each prompt you send to Claude Code, shows the fixes under it, and keeps them so /grammar stats and /grammar review show the mistakes you make most. Sends each prompt you type to Haiku (one small call per prompt), and the kept fixes to Sonnet when you run /grammar review, through your own Claude Code session
